_meta.status: DRAFT for Alex to sign off (docs/phase6/annotation_benchmark.md)
_meta.handedness: drawn for a right-hander; mirror the single panels (scaleX(-1)) for a left-hander; the *_pair files carry text and must not be mirrored

views.front_on: from behind the bowler (our camera); off side on the left for a right-hander
views.side_on: from point; the bowler to the right (chevron at the ground's right edge)

cue.what: eye-level line across the helmet visor
cue.fault: the line slants and earlier head positions trail behind

F01.alt: Two cartoon batters at set-up, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the head tilted and moving, eyes on a slant. This: the head still and the eyes level.

cue.what: plumb line straight down from the head
cue.fault: the line lands outside the feet
cue.correct: the line lands between the feet

F02.alt: Two cartoon batters at set-up, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: leaning to one side with the head outside the feet. This: weight even, head between the feet.

F17.caption_correct: Head, hands, feet over off stump

cue.what: vertical line up from off stump
cue.fault: head, hands and feet sit apart, the head beyond off stump
cue.correct: head, hands and feet stacked on the line

F17.alt: Two cartoon batters at set-up, seen from the bowler's end, with the stumps behind. Not this: head, hands and feet spread apart, the head leaning beyond off stump. This: head, hands and feet lined up over off stump.

cue.what: small bowler-at-release picture in the corner of both panels
cue.fault: the ball is leaving the bowler's hand and the bat is still on the ground
cue.correct: the ball is leaving the bowler's hand and the bat is already rising

F13.alt: Two cartoon batters seen from the side, each with a small bowler releasing the ball. Not this: the bat still resting on the ground. This: the bat already lifting.

cue.what: short line from the hands to the back hip
cue.fault: a long line: the hands are far out from the body
cue.correct: a short line: the hands are up and back, close to the body

F03.alt: Two cartoon batters at the top of the backlift, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the hands pushed far out from the body. This: the hands up and back, close to the body.

cue.what: the pitch from the side with a full zone near the batter and a short zone further away
cue.fault: the ball bounces in the short zone and arrives high, and the batter drives
cue.correct: the ball bounces in the full zone, close to the batter, and the batter drives

F19.alt: Two pitch diagrams seen from the side. Not this: the ball bounces short and arrives high, and the batter still drives. This: the ball bounces full, near the batter, so it is there to drive.
F19.note: Shot choice, not body position: the card has no measurement bar.

cue.what: footprints from above with the ball's line on the pitch
cue.fault: the front foot steps sideways across the crease (dotted trail)
cue.correct: the front foot steps out along the ball's line (arrow)

F15.alt: Two diagrams from above showing footprints at the crease. Not this: the front foot steps sideways across the crease. This: the front foot steps out towards the ball, along its line.

cue.what: the ball's line on the ground; an arrow from the head towards it on the correct panel
cue.fault: the foot steps out while the head and front shoulder stay upright, back
cue.correct: head and front shoulder lean towards the ball's line; the foot follows

F04.alt: Two cartoon batters stepping forward, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the foot steps out but the head and front shoulder stay back. This: the head and front shoulder lean towards the line of the ball first.

cue.what: the ball's line dashed on the ground, from the ball towards the stumps
cue.fault: the front foot lands well to the leg side of the line
cue.correct: the front foot lands on the line, or just inside it

F05.alt: Two cartoon batters stepping forward, seen from the bowler's end, with the line of the ball on the ground. Not this: the front foot lands well away from the line. This: the front foot lands on the line of the ball.

F06.caption_correct: Front knee bent, weight on it

cue.what: the front leg and knee filled in the accent colour
cue.fault: the front leg is locked straight and the body leans back
cue.correct: the front knee is bent over the front foot, taking the weight

F06.alt: Two cartoon batters at contact, seen from the side. Not this: the front leg locked straight, weight back. This: the front knee bent, the weight over it.

cue.what: an arrow along the back leg towards the bowler on the correct panel
cue.fault: the back heel is flat and the back knee bent, weight sitting back
cue.correct: the back heel is up and the back leg pushes the weight forward

F18.alt: Two cartoon batters at contact, seen from the side. Not this: the back foot flat and the weight back. This: the back heel up, pushing the weight forward.

F16.caption_correct: Head and chest over front foot

cue.what: plumb line straight down from the head
cue.fault: the line lands well behind the front foot
cue.correct: the line lands on the front foot

F16.alt: Two cartoon batters at contact, seen from the side. Not this: the head and chest stay back, well behind the front foot. This: the head and chest are over the front foot.

cue.what: the shoulder line as a dashed bar
cue.fault: a long bar: the chest has turned to face the bowler
cue.correct: a short bar: the front shoulder still points at the bowler

F07.alt: Two cartoon batters just before contact, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the chest turned square to the bowler, shoulders wide. This: the front shoulder still pointing down the pitch, shoulders narrow.

cue.what: the ball's line on the ground; the bat's path
cue.fault: a dotted trail shows the bat sweeping across the line
cue.correct: one arrow shows the bat coming straight down the line

F08.alt: Two cartoon batters at contact, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the bat swinging across the line of the ball. This: the bat coming straight down the line.

cue.what: the swing arc from the top of the backlift to contact
cue.fault: the arc is broken, with a pause mark at the top
cue.correct: one unbroken arc from backlift to contact

F09.alt: Two cartoon batters at the top of the backlift, seen from the side. Not this: the swing stops at the top. This: one smooth swing from the top down to the ball.

cue.what: vertical line from the head down to the ground
cue.fault: the line misses the ball: the head has fallen to the leg side and the ball is met away from the pad
cue.correct: the line runs through the ball, met next to the front pad

F10.alt: Two cartoon batters at contact, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: the head falls away and the ball is met away from the pad. This: the head is over the ball, next to the front pad.

cue.what: plumb line straight down from the head
cue.fault: the line lands outside the front foot: the body topples
cue.correct: the line lands on the front foot: balanced, held finish

F11.alt: Two cartoon batters at the finish, seen from the bowler's end. Not this: toppling to one side, the head outside the feet. This: a balanced finish, held, the head over the front knee.

cue.what: an arrow from contact up to the finish, towards the target, on the correct panel
cue.fault: the hands stop at waist height and the bat is checked
cue.correct: the hands carry on high towards the target

F12.alt: Two cartoon batters seen from the side. Not this: the hands stop at the ball. This: the hands carry on high towards the target.

cue.what: no cue: the clean figure at contact and at the finish
cue.correct: head over the ball at contact; a balanced, held finish

F00.alt: Two cartoon batters seen from the bowler's end, both with a tick: head over the ball at contact, and a balanced, held finish.

F14.note: F14 was retired in rubric v0.3 and is now part of F07.
